text: comparison.csv: by n, E2, the rapacious rule (“low”/“high”), Toda 2003, Toda 1962, family, lecture (the last two columns are in Russian).
sseqqweightS3p3.csv: the unstable Ext for S3 at p=3 by (n,s,e), as printed by qgradedims; rows n,s,e,dim, n=t-s.
e2metalib.csv: direct enumeration of the metalibrary by blocks (n,s,colour): the number of words, the rank of the differential, the dimension of E2, n≤64.
sseqS3p3.csv: the same Ext from sseq/ext without the weight; rows n,s,dim, n≤150.
differentials.json: the differentials of the rapacious rule (both fillings and the variant with d5).
toda2003S3.csv: our reading of the S3 column of Toda's 2003 table (the source column is in Russian).
